before: Paint hosts parked roots during virtualization but had no notification when the native surface ended. Forgotten host disposal retained React roots, measurements, and input listeners.
after: A local surface destruction callback restores borrowed paint and releases React roots, measurements, and input listeners. Explicit observer removal is idempotent and failed cleanup does not prevent other hosts from releasing.
reason: The callback and resource ownership affect local view lifetimes only. Canonical content, shared operations, payload encodings, and protocol versions do not change.
